name: maxey0-lab
description: Research tooling, and explicitly not part of the product. The spec-driven experiment harness: workload specs, conditions, leak probes, and reports. It shipped inside the plugin through 0.6.0 while the roadmap said since 0.3.0 that experiment protocol and analysis belong in a consumer repository — a measurement instrument that ships the study it was used for is a lab notebook with an installer. Install this only if you are running a study. Nothing in the three planes depends on it.
